title: Dental insurance
summary: Describes UnitedHealthcare branded dental insurance plans for individuals and families, what dental plans typically cover, plan types and why dental coverage matters.

atoms.title: UnitedHealthcare dental plans for individuals and families
atoms.question: What dental insurance plans does UnitedHealthcare offer?
atoms.text: UnitedHealthcare branded dental plans for individuals and families are underwritten by Golden Rule Insurance Company. Shoppers can choose plans that include basic dental coverage for general dental care, or explore coverage that includes major dental care, such as dental implants. Plans can be viewed by state using a ZIP code, or by calling 1-866-487-9301.

atoms.title: Dental insurance plans compared with savings memberships
atoms.question: Should I choose a dental insurance plan or a dental savings membership?
atoms.text: UnitedHealthcare offers two ways to manage dental costs. Dental insurance plans range from basic coverage to major dental care, such as dental implants. Dental savings memberships are an alternative to insurance that gives access to savings on common services from participating providers. UnitedHealthcare states that dental discount memberships are not insurance.

atoms.title: Preventive dental care coverage
atoms.question: How is preventive dental care typically covered?
atoms.text: Preventive dental care is often covered with no deductible or waiting period. UnitedHealthcare says this most often includes routine cleanings for all covered persons and fluoride treatments for those under the age of 16 on the plan.

atoms.title: Basic and major dental services
atoms.question: What are basic and major dental services?
atoms.text: Basic dental services often include simple fillings or emergency treatment for dental pain, and are subject to a deductible and coinsurance. Major services can include retainers and root canals; these are often subject to the plan's deductible, coinsurance and waiting periods. Preventive care, by comparison, is often covered with no deductible or waiting period.

atoms.title: Dental network and direct payment to dentists
atoms.question: Do I need to file claims with a dental plan?
atoms.text: UnitedHealthcare dental plans give access to a wide dental network, with a choice of dental providers that often includes offices in both private and retail settings. Plans pay in-network dentists directly, which makes payments easy to manage and means members do not need to submit claim forms.

atoms.title: Dental coverage with no age limits
atoms.question: Are there dental plans for seniors or people on Medicare?
atoms.text: UnitedHealthcare says its dental coverage has no age limits, with options available for every member of a family and every stage of life. Medicare does not include dental benefits, so the company offers plans designed specifically for seniors who are on Medicare.

atoms.title: Why dental benefits can matter for health and cost
atoms.question: Why should I have dental coverage?
atoms.text: UnitedHealthcare gives three reasons to have dental benefits. Better oral health: people with dental coverage are more likely to get routine dental care. Cost savings: if a person waits until there is a problem, dental care often gets more expensive and involved. Supports overall health: without preventive dental care, major health problems such as heart disease and diabetes appear more often.

atoms.title: Dental HMO versus dental indemnity plans
atoms.question: What is the difference between dental HMO and dental indemnity insurance?
atoms.text: A dental HMO (Health Maintenance Organization) has lower premiums, fixed copays for services, a restricted provider network that must be used, and no annual maximum. A dental indemnity plan has higher premiums, freedom to choose any dentist, coinsurance payments, an annual benefit maximum and no network discounts. UnitedHealthcare branded dental plans from Golden Rule Insurance Company are Dental PPO plans.

atoms.title: Why choose UnitedHealthcare dental plans
atoms.question: What are the advantages of UnitedHealthcare dental plans?
atoms.text: UnitedHealthcare highlights four features of its dental plans. Multiple plans with different benefit levels to fit different budgets; preventive care on day 1 of the plan with no waiting period; a nationwide network of dentists who offer dental work to members at negotiated lower rates; and, in most states, vision and hearing benefits are also available.

atoms.title: Dental plans sold alongside vision and cash-benefit plans
atoms.question: Can I get other supplemental coverage with a dental plan?
atoms.text: UnitedHealthcare points shoppers who want more than dental coverage to its supplemental plans, such as vision and cash-benefit plans, that offer coverage for expenses not covered by a medical plan. A plan finder is available to answer a few questions and show which insurance options may be available.
